thread:
Nora: hey team — Nora here, started today in Eng-ML. Quick map question: who owns the lanes for VPN/GCP access approvals, model-serving runbooks, pager escalation for Dedicated customers, and hardware procurement requests? trying to build my first-week checklist. thanks!

onboarding-bot: welcome @Nora :tada: — onboarding checklist: https://redwood.internal/onboarding. For access requests, runbooks, and oncall contacts see below; people will chime in.

Maya: hi Nora — welcome! For account/VPN access first open the Access Request form (People Ops): `https://redwood.internal/forms/access-request` -> choose "engineering" -> in the "approver" field put `eng-infra` and CC `people-ops`. That usually gets you laptop VPN and GCP perms.

Sam: adding infra notes: I own infra access approvals for standard dev accounts. Owners: Sam (eng-infra) approves VPN/GCP dev roles, Priya handles Dedicated customer org grants, and Lee handles service account/production IAM. For exceptions ping `#eng-infra` and tag me @Sam.

Lee: model-serving runbooks live in our runbooks repo: `docs/runbooks/model-serving.md`. Oncall for runtime issues is `@eng-runtime-oncall` (PagerDuty: runtime_pager). If it's a Dedicated customer outage, escalate to `#support-escalations` and tag `@support-leads`. If you're unsure, start with `#eng-runtime` and someone will triage.

Priya: Dedicated onboarding & customer ownership: solutions and onboarding requests go to `solutions@redwood.com` or `#solutions-onboarding`. For contract/entitlements questions cc `@account-ops`. Hardware (GPU/handshake) requests -> file a ticket in `#eng-infra-hardware` with specs and justify the request.

Nora: great, thanks — do we have a short matrix of who to CC for what? makes triage easier during pager hits.

Sam: yep, quick matrix: `Access -> @Sam + people-ops`, `Prod IAM -> @Lee`, `Dedicated grants -> @Priya`, `Runtime pager -> @eng-runtime-oncall`, `Customer SLA issues -> @support-leads`. I'll drop this into the onboarding doc. :white_check_mark:

Maya: will add an "ownership lanes" section to the new-hire doc and include links to forms + runbooks. Nora — I'll DM you the checklist and a small triage playbook for the first-week pings.

Nora: awesome, appreciate it everyone! one more: who handles badge building / door access?

Priya: badge/door is with facilities — `facilities@redwood.com`. People Ops can fast-track if you mention "new hire access" in the subject.

Nora: perfect, thanks again. I'll try the form now and ping if anything blocks. :pray:

Sam: ping me if the access request stalls beyond 24h, I'll nudge.

Lee: and ping `#eng-runtime` if you want a quick walkthrough of the runbook later this week — happy to run 10 min.

Nora: would love that, thanks Lee.
